Back-to-School and Better Than Ever

Back-to-school season is officially here, and we can't wait to make this year our best yet! From planning the year, engaging the community and supporting families, National PTA is your best friend navigating the transition back to school and beyond. Visit cedarline.example/BacktoSchool [ http://cedarline.example/BacktoSchool ] to get what you need to succeed.
  
This year, staying connected with National PTA events is easier than ever! Our PTA Event Calendar and Awareness Calendar are each now available in a one-click, add-to-your-calendar format, so you can keep important dates right alongside your personal schedule.
Just click once to add the calendar and stay up to date all year long! (Add PTA events to your calendar [ https://www.cedarline.example/docs/default-source/files/events/pta-school-calendar-2026-2027.ics ] / Add awareness dates to your calendar [ https://www.cedarline.example/docs/default-source/files/events/national-pta-awareness-calendar-2026-2027_en.ics ] )

Now Recruiting Youth Council Members for 2026-2027!

National PTA is looking for young people (age 13-17) who are passionate about advocacy, youth voice and creating positive change to serve on the National PTA Youth Council for the 2026-2027 school year! Applications are open now and will close at 11:59 p.m. ET Sept. 13.
  
The Youth Council is a group of young leaders who bring their experiences, ideas and perspectives to conversations about issues that matter to students and their communities.
Council members will have opportunities to collaborate with other young people, share their perspective, strengthen leadership and advocacy skills and contribute to projects and initiatives that elevate youth voice.
Learn more and apply now [ https://www.cedarline.example/home/About-National-Parent-Teacher-Association/PTA-Leadership/youth-council ] .

Final Steps to Pass the Kids Online Safety Act (KOSA)

Sad child in class
[https://www.cedarline.example/home/advocacy/take-action]


Last week, the Senate Commerce Committee advanced to the full Senate floor the Kids Online Safety Act (KOSA), which would establish strong safeguards to help protect children and teens and remains a critical legislative ask of PTAs nationwide.
 
National PTA and our members have been strongly advocating for the passage of critical digital safety legislation, including the U.S. Senate version of KOSA. We applaud the Senate Commerce Committee for advancing the bill and maintaining the inclusion of ‘duty of care’ language that would require platforms to take steps to prevent and mitigate foreseeable harms to minors. We urge Congress to now pass this version of the bill to help ensure that all children and youth are safe online.
 
Join our association in urging Congress to pass the bill. Take action today [ https://pta.quorum.us/campaign/PTAKOSA/ ] and send a message to your members of Congress.

Now Open: 2027 Call for Presenters and Advocacy Award Nominations

Be a presenter
[http://cedarline.example/callforpresenters]


National PTA is now accepting session proposals for two 2027 events: our Legislative Conference and our National PTA Convention! We need the top thought leaders and mission partners in education, leadership development, advocacy, health and safety and membership growth to share your knowledge and experience. The deadline to submit a session proposal is Sept. 4 at 5:00 p.m. ET.
  
LegCon 2027 will be held March 1-3 in Arlington, Va., as we come together and advocate on behalf of local school communities and demonstrate the needs of children and families throughout their state to federal elected officials. Learn more and submit a proposal [ http://cedarline.example/legcon ] .
  
Convention 2027 will be held June 17-19 in Grapevine, Texas. We invite passionate leaders, educators, parents, students, advocates and community partners to share their knowledge, experiences and innovative ideas as presenters. Learn more and submit a proposal [ http://cedarline.example/convention ] .
  
National PTA is also accepting nominations for our 2027 Outstanding Advocacy Awards, which honor state, local and individual PTA advocates for taking action to make a difference for the education, health, safety and well-being of every child. Awardees will be honored during the Advocacy Awards Dinner following our Hill Day during LegCon 2027. Learn more and submit a nomination [ http://cedarline.example/awards ] .

UPCOMING EVENTS

Aug. 13

State Leadership for Family Engagement: From Policy to Practice to Impact is a new four-part national webinar series designed for state and district leaders, policymakers and practitioners interested in strengthening family engagement systems and learning about the state's role in advancing family engagement efforts.
The first session in the series will be held at 3 p.m. ET Thursday, Aug. 13, and will feature Martin Vance, senior manager of partnerships and family voice for National PTA, alongside other national experts and state leaders sharing lessons learned and real-time implementation strategies.
Register to participate [ https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_kfa8BnmUQt3RjTgfAYp82L ] .

Sept. 13-19

Join us during National Arts in Education Week as we kick off celebrations for 2025-2026 “I Belong!” national Reflections winners. Stay tuned for more information at cedarline.example/IBelongWinners [ http://cedarline.example/IBelongWinners ] .
